end.summary:
Practised choosing exact or approximate values in everyday situations.
Explained approximate values as numbers close to the exact value.
Rounded 45,872,000 to the nearest thousand without changing it.

end.parentNote: Asha practised the difference between exact and approximate values and rounding to the nearest thousand and lakh. Ayaan used the digit to the right to decide whether to increase the rounding digit, and corrected the lakh example during the lesson. At home, practise rounding a few numbers to the nearest thousand, lakh, and crore, saying which digit gives the decision.
